name: THSV StreamBridge - Face Filters
author: surakage
description: Two broker-authorized, triggerless actions: Activate Lens turns on a Streamfog face lens by name, and Deactivate Lens turns it off when its time is up.

actions.name: THSV Extension - Face Filters - Activate Lens
THSV Extension - Face Filters - Deactivate Lens

triggerSafety: Activate Lens and Deactivate Lens must remain triggerless. StreamBridge supplies a one-use broker token, the Streamfog lens name, and a 5-600 second duration, then runs Deactivate Lens when that time is up.
verificationStatus: Streamfog sub-actions verified by the creator on Streamer.bot 1.1.0 (2026-10-19): Activate Lens by Name is type 37004 (lensName, duration) and turns the lens on but ignores the duration; Deactivate Lens is type 37002 and turns the current lens off.
